data.title: Ethereum breaks $2,560 resistance, eyes $2,760 ... | Pluang
data.description: Ethereum price surged past its $2,550–$2,575 resistance zone on September 20, now using this level as support. The token climbed over 75% from $1,510 to $2,650 in three months, marking its second-best quarterly gain on record. Institutional ETF inflows exceeded $10 billion in Q3, signaling strong demand, while Binance saw a three-year high in ETH withdrawals, indicating accumulation and long-term holding. Traders now target $2,760 and $3,000, with some predicting even higher prices by year-end.
data.author: Blockonomi
